answer: Attention-Tithe Windows: identities earn voice only by holding a live session open through unpredictable windows each epoch. A gale of short probes checks presence at random moments; missing enough windows voids accrued standing. Standing accrues in a vault released only after sustained, uninterrupted occupancy. Colluding farms must staff every window across many sessions simultaneously, so each extra synthetic identity costs continuous parallel human-equivalent attention, capping growth below the meadow of idle accounts a cheap sybil could otherwise seed.
